title: 15-Min Haloumi Pesto Pasta with Summer Veg
subtitle: On the table in a flash!
description: Leave it to us to make weeknight cooking even simpler and faster. Amped with a variety of brilliant ready-to-go ingredients to make life easier, you’ll love how quick and downright good this 15-minute recipe is!

steps.text: Cook haloumi: Bring a medium saucepan of salted water to the boil for the pasta. Thinly slice the zucchini. Drain and rinse the corn. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a medium deep frypan over high heat. Coarsely crumble the haloumi into the pan, breaking it into small bite-sized pieces. Cook the haloumi, stirring, for 2-3 mins until golden.

Cook pasta and veggies: Meanwhile, add the zucchini, corn and three-quarters of the pasta to the pan of boiling water. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 1½-2 mins until the pasta is al dente and the veggies are just tender. Reserve 2 tbs cooking water, then drain the pasta and veggies.

Serve up: Add the pesto and South American seasoning to the haloumi and cook, stirring, for 30 secs or until fragrant. Add the pasta and veggies and gently toss to combine. Gradually add the reserved cooking water, stirring constantly, until the sauce coats the pasta and looks slightly glossy. Divide the pasta among bowls and enjoy!
